# Optional Hunters

Optional encounter with [[Lord Umbraeth|Umbraeth]]'s hunters, between [[Fey Heart Scene - Race to Tree 1|the sleeping beast]] and [[Fey Heart Scene - Race to Tree 2|the tree attack]].

## Agreed direction

The hunters must be noticeable from the path, while investigating them remains a choice. The party can stay on the main route and continue with [[Gwydren]]. The scene should be a strange discovery off the path and reflect the increasingly angry forest.

## Working idea

%% Speculative ideas generated by AI at user request; not canon. %%

A visible side trail descends into a hollow. Hunting horns sound below, and the trees answer with distorted versions of the calls. Through the branches, the party glimpses hunters gathered around a fire. Gwydren identifies the sounds and makes clear that their route continues ahead.

An earlier possibility was a grove that traps the hunters: paths fold inward, branches catch their weapons, and their own calls return distorted. Whether to use this remains open.

## Still to design

- What the hunters are doing and what makes the hollow worth investigating.
- The player choices, challenge, and meaningful quest progress available here.
- The successful accomplishment that earns the first optional journey milestone.

## Exit and XP

Return to the route and continue toward [[Fey Heart Scene - Race to Tree 2|the tree attack]].

This scene occupies the first optional journey slot in [[Fey Heart XP Rewards]], worth **200 XP per PC** once its quest-progress objective is defined. The existing XP plan awards no separate combat XP for defeating hunters. [[Exploration Failure - Umbraeth's Hunters]] contains existing hunter encounter options.
